reviews.text: Thank you very much, Manuel, for your trust in our team. We will be available whenever you need us.
Eternal gratitude to the Hospital and all its professionals. Always impeccable and competent. They have been treating all six of our children for 8 years now. I recommend them without hesitation.

Excellent veterinary hospital, with an extremely professional, dedicated, and attentive team. From the very first moment, you notice the care and affection with which they treat each cat, in an environment designed specifically for their needs.

It's a benchmark in feline medicine in Lisbon, both for the quality of medical care and for the close support and interaction with pet owners.

Congratulations to the entire team for their excellent work! I highly recommend them.
Thank you, P.n.s, for your trust. We will be available whenever you need us.

We loved the welcoming atmosphere and professionalism of the entire team, especially Dr. Inês, who has been taking care of my feline with great affection and respect.
💗
Thank you, Wash. We are pleased to know that you were satisfied with the service and attention we provided.
Terrible service, very inhumane, I do not recommend it.

I HAVE NO WORDS TO DESCRIBE THIS HOUSE.
EVA AND CLARINHA, two rescued cats, destined for death on August 21, 2018, at only 2 days old, whom I saved with the help of their aunt Andreia, from the Moscavide clinic, where that space was their "school" until they were independent. Andreia, who picked them up from my work, and they would go on her motorbike to the "kindergarten" ♥️ I would leave work and pick them up, bring them home, and that was the routine for months. They passed away on July 19 and 31, 2026. Andreia was always behind everything, a pillar for me from the time they were born until her passing. I also want to thank the Algés clinic, where everything ended, Dr. Carolina, and all the others who were part of this process. Adra Carolina never left my side, I always felt supported by her, every word was like a hug for me, just like Andreia.
I thank the whole team, those who knew them know that they were a case study in general. They were my cats, yours too. ❤️ Thank you will never be enough.
Thank you so much, Carla, for trusting our Cat Hospital team. We will be available whenever you need us.
Thank you very much, Francisco, for your trust in our Cat Hospital team. We will be available whenever you need us.

The best veterinarian I've ever been to, but it's very difficult to get through to reception. They never answer.

I am very satisfied with the medical aspect.

I am very grateful to Dr. Laura Jesus and Dr. Maria João Azevedo for all the help they gave my cats.

The cat hasn't enjoyed its stay yet. But it will soon.

I checked out the facilities and the reception staff were very friendly and professional.
Thank you so much, Sofia, for trusting Hospital do Gato.

I don’t recommend these doctors at all… they’re salespeople more than vets. The doctor asked which food I give my cat, I said which wet food & Friskies dry food… the doctor then shamed my choice, told me that food was “terrible quality” & had “cheap grain fillers”. She repeatedly tried convincing me to buy Purina One directly from them (which contains the same “cheap grain fillers”). Even the cheapest supermarket brand cat foods have to pass rigorous European standards for safety, nutrition & quality control… so it’s highly unprofessional & classist to shame anyone’s cat food choices, especially if their cat likes it & is healthy. I have switched to a new vet who actually puts animals first!!

Edit in response to owner: I would like to clarify that your staff absolutely did pressure me to buy products from the brands sold at your clinic, as well as feliway diffusers without even asking if my apartment is suitable for them (it’s not, since my apartment is large I would need a lot of them & they don’t even work on my cats!!). And if the verbal pressure wasn’t sufficient, every room in your clinic is full of advertisements from these products.

After research & advice from my new vet (who does not sell products), I’ve switched to much better food for my cat, Purizon & Natural Greatness, which is far superior than any of the mid range supermarket brands that sponsor your clinic & university. If the cats welfare was your concern, you’d recommend ingredients, not brands. Your clinic is very unethical!

I took my cat in because he was vomiting. We were well attended to, however, the service was very slow because the veterinarian refused to sedate my cat. My cat is difficult to perform procedures without sedation, but the veterinarian said that wasn't how they worked.
As a result, my cat became much more stressed than if they had given him a sedative.
Thank you very much for your feedback, Nuno! We hope to welcome you back again soon.
Thank you very much, Patricia, for trusting Hospital do Gato.
Thank you very much, M.A., for trusting Hospital do Gato.
Excellent professionals, excellent human beings.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Natacha! We hope to welcome you back again soon.
Thank you so much, Elena, for your trust in our team. We will be available whenever you need us.

I do not recommend it. Lack of ethics and empathy.
Unfortunately, my experience with this cat hospital was terrible. They prioritize profit over the well-being of the animals, deceiving owners into performing very expensive treatments. They do not present a clear final budget and, given the severity of the illness, they do not propose real solutions — they only prolong the suffering to continue making money.
My cat ended up dying a few days later. It would have been much more humane and honest to clearly say that there was no solution, instead of charging a fortune for nothing. Lack of professionalism and, above all, of humanity. Do not entrust the lives of your felines to this place.
Highly unprofessional, lazy doctors who are much more concerned with selling their sponsored products than they are with animal welfare.

There are places that are more than just hospitals. They are havens when our hearts are filled with fear.

The Cat Hospital was that place for me and my Sissi. When chronic kidney disease entered our lives, it brought doubt, anguish, and an overwhelming feeling of helplessness. But there I found professionals who don't just care for animals: they also care for the families who love them.

Dr. Ana Cassapa deserves a very special mention. For her competence, dedication, patience, and the way she helped me understand Sissi's illness, to learn, to gain courage, and not to give up. There are professionals who treat, but there are others who leave a mark. Dr. Ana left a very beautiful mark on our path.

I also want to express my deepest gratitude to all the professionals at the Cat Hospital, especially the team that is present 24 hours a day. Knowing that someone is there, at any time, prepared to care for our animals in their most fragile moments, has an indescribable value.

It's not always possible to cure. But it's always possible to care with love, respect, knowledge, and humanity. And that's what I found at the Cat Hospital.

Thank you to Dr. Ana Cassapa and the entire team for taking care of my Sissi as he deserved to be cared for. I will never forget it.

— Sofia Silva

Terrible experience. Incompetent staff who always try to hospitalize the animals. They told me the cat was terminally ill and needed to be hospitalized immediately... I sought second and third opinions and both told me there was nothing wrong with the cat. I paid €300 for nothing. Run away from this place!
I recommend it!
Thank you, João, for your feedback. We are pleased to know that your experience with us was positive.

I picked up my cat Arigato today.

He came back worse than when he arrived.

Soaked in urine, prostrate and sedated.

If you have another hospital to leave your cat at, please don't even think twice... run away from there.

My cat ended up dying 8 hours after leaving that place.

Negligence, crime, incompetence.

Lies in the phone calls where he was fine, eating on his own, everything made it seem like everything was going perfectly.

But no... Arigato was put to sleep that same night because he was in agony.
Rest in peace my dear, justice will come.

We regret that your experience was not satisfactory, Rita. Since no comment was left, we are unable to identify the situation or understand how we can help you.
If you would like us to analyze what happened or clarify any issue, we are available by phone or email to assist you in a personalized way.
Highly competent and dedicated. Excellent service and support!

Initially, I had what I considered a positive experience, mainly due to the team's friendliness and communication. However, over time and after follow-up care abroad, my perception changed significantly.

My cat continued to have health problems after discharge, and a persistent anemia and spleen abnormalities were later identified, which were not properly explained to me during the follow-up. I only had access to some tests, such as the ultrasound, after leaving the clinic.

I was left with the feeling that the clinical condition was mainly controlled through medication, without a complete clarification of the underlying cause or exclusion of other possibilities. Furthermore, the blood values—particularly those related to red blood cell regeneration—did not evolve as expected, without a clear explanation being given at the time.

Based on this experience, and considering what was subsequently identified, I cannot recommend them.
Professionalism and excellent service.
Thank you, Maria, for your feedback. We are pleased to know that your experience with us was positive.
Great vet for cats ONLY.
Thank you, Juvenal, for your trust. We will be available whenever you need us.
Thank you very much, Paulo, for taking the time to write your review. We are happy to know that you are satisfied with our service. We will continue to be available whenever you need us.
Excellent
Thank you very much, Bernardo, for your support and trust.
Thank you so much, Maria, for trusting our Cat Hospital team. We will be available whenever you need us.
Your Cat's Best Friends!
Thank you very much, Hélio, for your support and trust.
We are so happy to have found the Cat Hospital, but in particular, to have been cared for by Dr. Filipa. Dr. Filipa is incredibly patient, technically rigorous, and kind! Thank you so much!
Forget about calling them, they don't answer! It's infuriating!!!!
I had a good experience during a very difficult time. The team that assisted me was very attentive and helpful, providing good service for both my cat and me.
Thank you very much, Teresa, for your support and trust.
About 5 years ago I found the Algés/Restelo Cat Hospital and the group of excellent professionals who care for and help me through good times and bad. Thank you all, and especially Dr. Ana Cassapo.
Thank you very much, Rita, for your support and trust.
I'm only not giving it a zero because it's impossible. They got my cat's diagnosis wrong twice in a row. They work for vaccines, but not for more serious issues.

Very professional and kind.

Congratulations to the whole team.
Thank you for your trust.

We couldn't be happier with the service and how they treated and continue to treat our kitten Ollie. From the reception staff to the very attentive Dr. Andreia Agostinho, we always felt in excellent hands. Dr. Patrícia and Dr. Laura were also very attentive when Dr. Andreia wasn't there. We decided to try their services and we certainly won't change. Our two kittens are now part of the Cat Hospital family and we couldn't be happier that they are in such good hands. I recommend it to all owners who love their little felines. A place that treats cats with love, care and attention and knows what it's doing.
Thank you very much for your feedback.
Competence, availability, flexibility, friendliness.
Your trust motivates us every day!
Thank you for your feedback.
Thank you very much for your trust!
Thank you for the recognition.
Thank you for your feedback.
Thank you for the feedback.
By far the best

Five-star service upon arrival and departure.
Friendliness is the name of the game here.
I feel at home (except for the Boss) and so does our future little girl, Nina! She is very loved here by everyone.
I am so, so happy!
Nina is here to help us and to love each other. Here at home, Nina will find much peace, much joy, and immense laughter every day.

Nina, I can't wait to have you with me every day, to love and respect you for the rest of my life.

Helena Teixeira
Spectacular service. The nurses and vets are so loving and caring! And so patient with our old grumpy cat! Thank you!
Excellent veterinary hospital
Thank you for your feedback!
My first experience at the place was wonderful. Great location with excellent professionals. I highly recommend it.

Excellent service from the team in general, but Dr. Andreia Agostinho is an attentive and concerned veterinarian. She explains everything and guides from beginning to end, with great clarity.
Thank you for the excellent care given to Chulo today 🙏🏼☺️
I highly recommend

I want to thank the entire team at the Cat Hospital, and especially Dr. Mariana Branco and Dr. Filipa Barreto, for all the dedication, kindness, attention, and professionalism they showed during the final moments of my cat Jobim, my companion of 18 years, who passed away on November 23, 2025. Thank you.
Thank you for your trust!

Since its opening, it was the Cat Hospital that took care of our Menina. One month after her passing (after 17 years of life), we can only thank the entire team at Restelo/Algés Hospital for their professionalism, dedication, kindness, and solidarity in caring for our Bia and for the support they gave us during all the difficult hours we went through. Your affection for our Menina while treating her, your words of comfort to us will always remain in our hearts.
Grateful to the entire team, we must mention the team that was closest to our Bia:
Dr. Maria João Diniz Da Fonseca, Dr. Joana, Dr. Bárbara, Dr. Laura, Dr. Andreia, Dr. Diogo, Dr. Filipa. Nurse Mónica, the receptionists Sofia, Margarida, and Alexandra. They are an example of professionalism and dedication, each with something that, even amidst the tears of loss, makes us remember them fondly for their attention.
When and if we get a cat again, this will definitely be the place to return to.
Thank you very much! Best wishes!
They are fantastic! My cat has never been so well cared for.

I will be eternally grateful to the team at the Cat Hospital, especially Dr. Andreia Agostinho. Katara was always treated very well by the entire team. The professionalism is extremely high, and the environment is always very clean.
A 5-star hospital exclusively for cats. Thank you so much for everything.

Excellent professionals.

I've been a client since they opened and they've never disappointed me.

Great personal support when needed.
Highly recommended
Everything was 5 stars!!! From reception, assistants, nursing staff and veterinary medical team!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Spectacular team, once again 5 stars, thank you all without exception!
Thank you so much for your feedback!

The clinic is corrupt, the doctors and staff are incompetent, and we paid 500 euros for 2 days with a catheter inserted to flush the bladder for cystitis. On the second day, the medical staff removed the collar so that my cat could rest, and my cat pulled the catheter out of its penis. However, they did not insert the catheter again, even though we had paid for 2 days with the catheter. we were discharged and we had to go back to the clinic in 2 days and they asked us for another 500 euros and so they pulled out 2000 euros and my cat is still in a serious condition. this is the worst clinic, do not go there, they will pump you for nothing and the animal will be left without help

My cat (who was being treated by another veterinarian) had to be urgently hospitalized, and we decided to contact the Algés Cat Clinic, which I recommend 200%. From the first phone call, the consultation with Dr. Diogo, to the day of discharge, we felt supported and secure by all the staff. The veterinarians were always 5-star whenever they called to give us updates. I recommend them without hesitation! Thank you again, Cat Clinic 🐈‍⬛🤍
Thank you for your feedback. We hope to see you again soon.

We adopted a kitten a few weeks ago and it was our first time there, we loved it! They are excellent people, with immense kindness. We were very happy to have chosen the Cat Hospital to take our little one. Dr. Patricia is incredible, a person who clearly loves what she does. The lady at reception is also very friendly, always willing to help, and they treat the cats very well. Without a doubt, our little one will always be followed there, and I will highly recommend it. Thank you for everything.

I absolutely do not recommend them. I took my cat to Dr. Patrícia Costa several times and it only got worse. They are terrible. They only focus on creating "patient subscriptions" and not on solving problems.
Thank you Paulino for your feedback, we hope to see you again at the Cat Hospital!

We went to this hospital with my 14-year-old senior cat (she would be 15 at the end of this month) last night, with typical urinary tract infection symptoms. Around 6:45/7:00 pm we were seen and after the medical history and sample collection, we were told that a urine analysis would be necessary. At that point, we stopped following the consultation because she was taken to another part of the clinic. We still heard Sascha meowing a few times until she stopped. A few minutes later, the veterinarian who was attending to Sascha came to us and told us that they had managed to extract urine but that Sascha had had an episode of vasovagal syncope and had fainted and that they would like to keep her under observation for a few more hours, until around 10:00 pm.

We went for a walk around the neighborhood to kill time and returned to the hospital two and a half hours later, around 10 PM as expected. After a short wait, they called us, and Sascha was already in the cat carrier, wet and smelling strongly of ethyl alcohol, visibly lethargic or sedated/anesthetized. We were then told that the urinary tract infection was confirmed, given the respective medications and dosage, and that she had already been given an antibiotic and a "relaxant," medication that was supposed to be resumed today (the following day). That it was normal for her to be more lethargic now because of the "relaxant." We left the hospital with Sascha, and as soon as we got home and opened the cat carrier, she came out with difficulty, lying down in a corner of the house, with her mouth open and drooling. We associated this lethargy and symptoms with the "relaxant" that was supposedly applied, as we were told when they handed Sascha back to us. He died of convulsions about 3 hours later, at 1:20 am this morning. He was admitted with a simple clinical picture of urinary tract infection, and died a few hours later in a state of prostration and distress.

On May 30th, 2025, my 11-year-old cat underwent emergency surgery to treat pyometra (uterine infection). I considered the costs very high (around €800), but clearly, given the circumstances, I had to accept. The operation went well, and she was hospitalized overnight. The post-operative diagnosis was positive, and she was discharged the following day.

In the first few days after surgery, she remained lethargic—something normal given the situation she was in. Two weeks later, on June 15th, I took her to the follow-up appointment at the Odivelas Clinic, as recommended. Although she was still very weak and lethargic, I was informed that "everything was fine," and she was only given an analgesic. I was told that "the behavior could be due to the heat." The consultation lasted 5 minutes and cost an additional €30, which I consider a completely disproportionate amount considering it was a post-surgery follow-up. Today, June 29th, she remains lethargic, with difficulty eating and drinking water. I will go to the hospital for the third time, where they immediately told me that because it's Sunday the price is €79, which is ridiculous given the circumstances. At this moment I do not recommend this hospital; I am not satisfied, and my cat is even less so, as she is definitely not well. I will return here after today's consultation for a new evaluation.
Thank you very much for your feedback.
Had great and lowsy experiences there. Recommend Dr Ines Guerra and Dr Ana Cassapo
The staff is super professional and attentive. They adjust the clinical plan to the needs of each pet, their routine, and their lifestyle. I highly recommend them!

Always 5 stars for years. My furry friend is practically part of the family. A senior dog with many ailments, but always treated with great care and attention. Professionalism, affection for the owners, and lots of empathy. THANK YOU

I want to thank all the staff; they couldn't have been more attentive during this very difficult time for me, which was the separation from my life partner. My heartfelt thanks. A big hug to Dr. Barbara Durão.

Love for cats, attention, care, affection, and information for pet owners to make their little ones' lives better, more comfortable, and safe.
Thank you! 😻 …
Best cat treatment in the Lisbon area.
Excellent service, I will definitely continue bringing my cat to be seen in the parking lot.
Simply fantastic.

I received a quote €150 above average, with fewer add-ons compared to other veterinarians.
The prices for all services provided appear to be, on average, double those of any other veterinarian.

After paying almost €1000, my cat left the clinic with an open wound the size of an orange... incredibly, nobody knows what happened... four months later, they still don't know what happened... Don't take your animals to this clinic because it's almost certain they will be mistreated.
The cost/efficiency ratio is extraordinarily unbalanced, as it is extremely expensive and inefficient. Therefore, I do not recommend it at all.

I have many years of experience interacting with veterinarians (I've always had pets) and my experience with the Cat Hospital is, by far, the worst ever.

I went to the cat hospital because my vet, Dr. Joana Valente - Alma Vet, is on maternity leave.

After several days without any positive results and with very vague explanations, "we saw in the ultrasound that there are no more foreign bodies" (and they refuse to give me the images of this second ultrasound), I decided to change veterinarians, who immediately identified the presence of the foreign body and operated on the cat, in extremis.

If I had followed the recommendations and instructions of the Cat Hospital, my cat would have died.

I contacted the cat hospital, explaining what happened and asking for feedback, but I received no response (the email was sent on January 31st, it's now February 13th).

Absolute incompetence.
Absolute indifference towards animals.
Absolute lack of respect for owners. Not only do I not recommend it, but I go in the opposite direction. We should want nothing more than distance from the cat hospital. A lot of it.

I had already spent a lot of money on my cat at clinic X; at the time, I even said my cat had FIP, and the vet hadn't taken it seriously.

Then I started being treated by Dr. Andréia, who is super attentive and saved Ollie's life—a true angel.

My cat was extremely well cared for by dedicated professionals who always put her well-being first. I recommend the Cat Hospital to everyone who has cats. A special thank you to Drs. Patrícia Costa and Patrícia Morais, who were essential in improving my cat's health.
The affection, the attention, the care, the professionalism, a smile and a hug when the owner needs it most. Thank you.

Despite the circumstances, our experience with the team at the Cat Hospital was exceptional. The attention and care they gave our cat was very reassuring – not only did he fully recover from the problem that led to his hospitalization, but we also felt informed and involved in the recovery process. They provided regular contact, allowed visits several times a day, and offered attentive follow-up after discharge.

Thank you to the entire Cat Hospital team!

I took my cat to get an x-ray, and in the process, they referred me to the veterinary university along with emails about the x-ray, which is all covered by insurance. They told me to go there, but when I got there, they said there were no appointments available, meaning my cat could have died due to a lack of communication between them.

The receptionists are friendly, but they failed miserably in terms of communication.

*Lack of Transparency and Poor Communication in My Cat's Treatment*

My cat had a spaying surgery in October 2023, during which there were complications. Three days after the surgery, when she went for a check-up, she had an evisceration and had to undergo another surgery. They said the second surgery would be free of charge and claimed the complication was because “my cat wasn’t using the vest properly.” I told them I have experience with cats, but they insisted it was my fault and were evasive. She wore the vest for a whole month and was on antibiotics. In the end, the treating vet refused to do any more check-ups and referred us to the surgeon who performed the original surgery. The last check-up was done by email, where I sent photos. Now, in December 2024, we no longer live in Portugal, and my cat is suffering from gastrointestinal issues. The cause: a hospital-acquired infection, which they never informed me about.
I consulted with two specialists. My cat has large scars on her abdomen from the surgery, which isn’t normal. What happened was a **hospital-acquired infection** that was never communicated to me and caused the wound to deteriorate, open, expand, and lead to evisceration. Now my cat has adhesions that are causing issues, and she needs to be operated on again. This wasn’t a surgical problem, but an infection that complicated everything, and they failed to inform me! Surgical complications can happen, but **do not hide information**. If I had known, I wouldn’t have wasted time, and the veterinarians would have been aware of this history. Terrible experience and dishonesty!
I lowered the star rating because my last experience with this hospital wasn't the best.
Very attentive, caring, and friendly.
24-hour service, good support, and good conditions. Only the prices are very high.

My cat was seen twice by Dr. Patrícia Costa; from unnecessary medication to three procedures to dictate what one confirmed…
If I hadn't taken the cat to another veterinarian, she would have undergone several operations with a much higher degree of procedure than necessary; possibly the cat, at her age, wouldn't have survived. Apparently, it's not the first time they've subjected animals to inhumane treatment!!

I don't usually give negative reviews, but when it comes to a lack of professional ethics for money, abusing animals and the affection that owners have for them… it's unacceptable.
Terrible service

Excellent hospital! They treated my cat when he was admitted with a fever of 41 degrees Celsius and a giant abscess, having been in critical condition for several days. It's impossible to thank and praise the excellent work of the entire team that treated Chico enough. Dr. Laura Jesus is an excellent doctor, and we are clearly convinced that this is the best hospital to take our cats to if necessary in the future.

The clinic neglected my cat's well-being and left him on the brink of death. Finally, they took advantage of our emotional vulnerability to illegally take him away from us. The cat is unwell and doesn't adapt easily. He's been with us for 8 …
